Landed · 2026-11-10T13:58Z · PR #32186 merged as `90523639` (`Fixes #32121` closed this card). The seat removes `pm:dispatched` and its assignee.

**For repo:cloud (the SCIM console, cloud#4278 item 4).** `sys_idp_group_mapping` now carries three read-only fields: `match_status` (`matched` / `unmatched` / `not_applicable`; an SSO-sourced mapping reads `not_applicable`), `matched_group_id` (the `sys_scim_group` id it matches, empty when none) and `match_changed_at`. plugin-auth keeps them current on every SCIM group create, rename and delete, and on every mapping save, and re-judges all rows once per boot. A row saved before the upgrade reads right after the first boot. They describe the row only; grants are unchanged (an unmatched mapping still grants nothing). Read them through the object's existing list API. Every cloud mailbox on this repo is closed, so this note is left here on the card. Ships in the next release carrying `@objectstack/platform-objects` and `@objectstack/plugin-auth`.
